minecraft:written_book_content.title: Jungle Camp Foreman's Log
minecraft:written_book_content.author: R. Okafor
pages: {"text": "Day 3. Got a fridge for the office.\n\nDay 6. Radio check with the swamp camp. Mallory hasn't found a single grain. He asked about my fridge twice. I may have described it in detail."}
{"text": "Day 9. The mining elevator is down. Night shift says there was a \"blue flash\" and the cable just melted through. Clean cut. Glowing.\nRequisitioned a new cable. Blamed the heat."}
{"text": "Day 11. Strange clicking from the treeline at night. Rhythmic. Crew says it's birds. I have never heard a bird click in sentences."}
{"text": "Day 14. Second elevator cable melted. Another blue flash. Nobody saw who. Nobody saw anything. Hendricks has stopped going near the trees."}
{"text": "Day 16. Night shift took the camp rifles and went into the trees after the clicking.\nThey didn't come back.\nFound their helmets lined up neatly on the elevator platform."}
{"text": "Same night. Office door torn off its hinges. Taken: two drills, the welding torch...\nand the fridge.\nWHO STEALS A FRIDGE."}
{"text": "Day 17. Radioed Mallory. He complained about mud, frogs, and a worker who steals rocks.\nIt sounded wonderful. Quiet. Nobody steals fridges in a swamp."}
{"text": "Day 18. Ruiz from the elevator crew is missing too.\nThe clicking was very close tonight.\nRequesting a transfer to the swamp."}
